messages:
incidentbot: PagerDuty alert PDR-9087 - CRITICAL: inference-gateway-usw2 reporting elevated 502 rate. Metric: 502_rate = 5.2% over 5m (threshold 1.5%). Affected endpoints: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. Runbook: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-502>. Pager link: pd://PDR-9087

raj_oncall: ack — I'm oncall and taking this. Starting triage: pulling region dashboards and recent deploys. @sam_sre can you grab envoy + model-worker logs for usw2? :eyes:

sam_sre: on it. tailing envoy proxys now. seeing a lot of `upstream_reset_before_response` and 502s with upstream connection resets. grabbing pod logs from inference-worker-*/gpu-usw2-3

emma.k: noticing console traces showing request latency spikes (~>1s) for a subset of traffic. A handful of customers filed degraded responses (not full outage). tagging @support_lead for customer comms.

pagerduty: PDR-9087 acknowledged by raj_oncall (first responder). If unresolved in 15m, escalation to SRE rotation will occur.

sam_sre: found repeated "Killed process" lines in model-worker stdout on gpu-usw2-3 around 02:41 UTC. OOM kills correlated with memory growth after 02:30 when a canary rollout of quantized-v2 was applied. Suspect rollout caused mem spike under certain seq-length patterns.

sam_sre: logs snippet:
```
Jul 22 02:41:12 worker[pid=2345]: Alloc failed: requested 18.3Gi, available 16.0Gi
Jul 22 02:41:12 kernel: Killed process 2345 (model-worker) total-vm: 27324544kB
```

raj_oncall: rolling back canary now to previous stable revision and patching mem limits. Commands: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-canary -n inference` && `kubectl patch deployment inference-worker --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"model-worker","resources":{"limits":{"memory":"24Gi"}}}]}}}}' -n inference`

incidentbot: Change detected: rollback initiated by raj_oncall. Monitoring metrics for 3m window.

emma.k: after ~4m post-rollback: 502 rate dropped to 0.4%, tail latencies trending back to baseline. Customer reports reduced errors. Marking as mitigated for now. :thumbsup:

pagerduty: PDR-9087 RESOLVED by raj_oncall. Follow-up ticket INF-924 created for: tighter canary memory safety checks, canary traffic cap, and improved OOM alerts for model-worker.

raj_oncall: adding postmortem notes: immediate cause = canary model variant memory spike on longer sequences; mitigation = rollback + memory limit. Action items: INF-924 (owner: sam_sre), increase canary isolation for heavy-seq traffic, add guardrail to auto-scale memory on model-worker or fail-canary early.

support_lead: thanks team — I'll prepare a short customer-facing incident note for impacted customers and sync with CS.
